verified_facts.text: The hotel sits between the City of London and the River Thames.
verified_facts.excerpt: Tucked away between The City of London and the River Thames, The Westin London City is a perfectly positioned home base for exploring London.

verified_facts.text: The hotel overlooks Bankside and is a few minutes from the West End and South Bank.
verified_facts.excerpt: Overlooking bankside, and a few minutes away from the West End and South Bank

verified_facts.text: Some rooms have views of St Paul's Cathedral.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our London hotel offers rooms with spectacular views of the historic St. Paul’s Cathedral.

verified_facts.text: Each residence has three bedrooms, a balcony overlooking the River Thames and a fully equipped kitchen.
verified_facts.excerpt: Each residence boasts three bedrooms, a balcony overlooking the River Thames, and a fully equipped kitchen.

verified_facts.text: The St Paul's Duplex Suites have floor-to-ceiling windows over two floors and a one-bedroom mezzanine.
verified_facts.excerpt: These one-of-a-kind Duplex Suites feature floor-to-ceiling windows over two floors offering the ultimate London experience. These exclusives suites offer a one-bedroom mezzanine

verified_facts.text: The Presidential Suite has a private terrace facing the sunset over St Paul's.
verified_facts.excerpt: Watch the sun setting on St. Paul’s from the comfort of your private terrace.

verified_facts.text: Room interiors feature oak timber panelling, rich green hues and curved lines inspired by nature.
verified_facts.excerpt: furnishings seek inspiration from the natural world in its purest form and feature oak timber panelling, rich green hues, matt finishes, and curved lines.

verified_facts.text: The Heavenly Spa by Westin has a swimming pool, steam room, sauna, sensorial shower, vitality pool and ice fountain.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our spa features high-end facilities, including lavish treatments rooms as well as a 12-metre swimming pool, steam room and sauna, a sensorial shower, vitality pool and ice fountain.

verified_facts.text: The fitness studio has Technogym bikes and equipment, TRX and a Hypervolt recovery station.
verified_facts.excerpt: From a world-class bike experience with Technogym bikes to TRX to Technogym exercise equipment and a bespoke Hypervolt recovery station

verified_facts.text: Hithe + Seek is a riverside bar and kitchen with unobstructed views across the River Thames.
verified_facts.excerpt: Hithe + Seek is a riverside bar and kitchen with unobstructed views across the River Thames

verified_facts.text: The Champagne bar is run in partnership with Taittinger and offers flight tastings with City views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our Taittinger champagne bar in London offers Signature and Vintage Cuvée references, plus flight tastings with City views.

verified_facts.text: None of the hotel rooms face the River Thames; the river view is from the Hithe + Seek wine bar.
verified_facts.excerpt: None of our hotel rooms face the River Thames however you will be able to enjoy the river view from our beautiful wine bar Hithe + Seek.

verified_facts.text: The hotel operates a cashless policy.
verified_facts.excerpt: Please note that we are operating a cashless policy.

verified_facts.text: The nearest public car park, NCP Thames Vintry, is about a 10-minute walk away.
verified_facts.excerpt: The closest car parking facilities to the property are the NCP Thames Vintry, this is a locally managed parking facility that is circa 10-minute walk to the property.

verified_facts.text: One dog up to 15 kilograms is welcome per room.
verified_facts.excerpt: One pet is allowed per room, with a maximum weight of 15.0 kgs.
